description: TeachBench evaluates LLMs as teacher agents by having them conduct multi-turn instruction over structured knowledge points derived from an exam syllabus, with a fixed-capability student agent as a learner proxy.
title: TeachBench

description: Observer reports were collected through teacher nominations in which teachers selected up to 5 students they considered at the high and low ends of emotion regulation ability from alphabetical lists of students they taught.
title: Teacher nomination procedure for observer-reported emotion regulation

description: The article adopts the teacher noticing framework of Van Es and Sherin to model how teachers make sense of classroom and dashboard situations.
title: Teacher noticing framework: detection and interpretation of classroom situations

description: The TNRF builds on van Es and Sherin's expanded noticing framework of attending, interpreting, and shaping, and \"extends van Es and Sherin's (2021) framework by specifying the object of noticing more precisely as students' mathematical thinking\".
title: Teacher Noticing of Rationality Framework (TNRF)

description: The Teacher Team Method is one of three methods the article proposes for estimating teacher value added when students are co-taught.
title: Teacher Team Method for co-taught value-added estimation

description: The study defines teacher performance using value-added estimates from a student-level growth model with teacher fixed effects.
title: Teacher value-added modeling for performance classification

description: The article proposes a lightweight diagnostic that reaggregates public tutoring benchmark scores into two composites: a solving composite (problem solving, solution correctness, mistake location, mistake correction) and a pedagogy composite (socratic questioning, scaffolding win rate, pedagogy instr
title: Teaching-over-solving diagnostic

description: The article proposes that tutor-agent readiness requires three separable capability surfaces: Stage 1 pedagogical judgment (a bounded teacher decision from packaged evidence), Stage 2 situated tutoring (a history-dependent adaptive teaching policy over a multi-turn episode), and Stage 3 end-to-end L
title: Teaching-system episode framework: knowing–teaching–acting across three capability surfaces

description: The review adopts the Teaching Through Interactions (TTI) framework as its organizing model for classroom-level interaction quality, integrating attachment theory and self-determination theory.
title: Teaching Through Interactions framework

description: The TEL evaluation framework, developed in the context of medical education and built on the CIPP evaluation model and the Kirkpatrick model, guides both development and evaluation activities for e-learning resources.
title: Technology-enhanced learning (TEL) evaluation framework

description: Temporal networks are a method that models both the relational aspects (who interacts with whom) and the temporal aspects (order, duration, concurrency) of collaborative learning.
title: Temporal network analysis

description: TSDR is a model-agnostic debiasing framework for knowledge tracing that integrates a doubly robust estimator — combining Inverse Propensity Weighting with error imputation — with a temporal smoothness regularizer on the imputation model's latent trajectory.
title: Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework for debiased knowledge tracing

description: The review proposes a framework of ten dimensions that characterize MSL, derived from a review of recent academic papers on mobile-assisted seamless learning.
title: Ten-dimension framework characterizing mobile-assisted seamless learning

description: The article applies ten criteria of \"positive experiences\" developed by Jantzen et al.
title: Ten experience criteria for analyzing positive learning experiences

description: The review organizes family medicine education research into a set of topic areas identified through scoping review of 624 articles.
title: Ten-topic-area taxonomy of family medicine education research

description: Extending Bales' division of social interaction into a task zone and a socio-emotional zone, the author and Andriessen developed a formal analysis method aimed at studying \"the 'interaction' between deepening of a conflict (extending down into an argument chain) and fluctuations in tension-relaxatio
title: Tension-relaxation analysis of interpersonal relations in collaborative argumentation

description: The article examines two techniques for accounting for test disengagement: \"removing unengaged test takers from the sample\" and \"adjusting test scores to remove rapidly guessed items\".
title: Test disengagement adjustment through sample removal and rapid-guess score correction

description: Because CAT administrations give different students different items, item-level factor analysis is impractical: for MAP, \"typical missing rates are around 98%\".
title: Testlet-level CFA for assessing dimensionality of CAT data

title: Text-based cognitive mapping method for measuring team shared mental models
